command:
cd /app && echo '--- tools ---' && for x in python3 sqlite3 xxd od hexdump; do command -v "$x" || true; done && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
for fn in ['main.db','main.db-wal']:
    b=pathlib.Path(fn).read_bytes()
    print('\n', fn, len(b))
    print(b[:128].hex(' '))
    print(repr(b[:64]))
    if fn.endswith('-wal') and len(b)>=32:
        magic,fmt,ps,ckpt,s1,s2,c1,c2=struct.unpack('>IIIIIIII', b[:32])
        print('wal header', hex(magic), fmt, ps, ckpt, hex(s1), hex(s2), hex(c1), hex(c2))
        n=(len(b)-32)//(ps+24)
        print('frames approx', n)
        for i in range(min(n,5)):
            off=32+i*(ps+24)
            print(' frame',i, b[off:off+24].hex(' '))
    if fn=='main.db':
        print('sqlite header', b[:16])
        print('page size field', struct.unpack('>H', b[16:18])[0])
PY
echo '--- sqlite query base ---' && if command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null; then sqlite3 main.db '.schema' 'SELECT * FROM sqlite_master;' 'SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY id;' 2>&1; else echo no sqlite3; fi

cd /app && cp -n main.db-wal main.db-wal.encrypted.bak && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src = Path('main.db-wal.encrypted.bak').read_bytes()
dec = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in src)
Path('main.db-wal.decrypted').write_bytes(dec)
print('orig', len(src), 'decrypted', len(dec))
print('decrypted header', dec[:32].hex(' '))
import struct
magic, fmt, pgsz, ckpt, s1, s2, c1, c2 = struct.unpack('>IIIIIIII', dec[:32])
print('magic=%#x fmt=%d pgsz=%d ckpt=%d salts=%#x,%#x checksums=%#x,%#x' % (magic, fmt, pgsz, ckpt, s1, s2, c1, c2))
print('frames', (len(dec)-32)//(pgsz+24), 'remainder', (len(dec)-32)%(pgsz+24))
for i in range((len(dec)-32)//(pgsz+24)):
    off=32+i*(pgsz+24)
    print('frame', i, 'hdr', dec[off:off+24].hex(' '), 'page_start', dec[off+24:off+40].hex(' '))
PY
rm -rf /tmp/walscratch && mkdir -p /tmp/walscratch && cp main.db /tmp/walscratch/test.db && cp main.db-wal.decrypted /tmp/walscratch/test.db-wal && echo '--- scratch query with decrypted WAL ---' && sqlite3 /tmp/walscratch/test.db "PRAGMA journal_mode; SELECT count(*) FROM items; SELECT id,name,value FROM items ORDER BY id;" 2>&1 && echo '--- scratch files after query ---' && ls -la /tmp/walscratch
